newsitem.title: KENYA: KENYA COFFEE PRICES MOSTLY LOWER AT AUCTION.
newsitem.headline: KENYA COFFEE PRICES MOSTLY LOWER AT AUCTION.

text.p: Kenyan coffee prices were generally lower at the weekly export auction on availabilities of roaster stocks from overseas, auction officials said on Tuesday.
They said C grades dropped by an average $35 and premium ABs by $10 but higher-quality coffees gained in price, dealers said.
"Higher qualities, as long as they were of solid appearance, fetched good premiums," one trader said.
The Coffee Board of Kenya sold 20,342 of the 20,767 60-kg bags on offer, compared with 20,323 of the 20,419 bags auctioned last week.
